title: Zesty Molten Mexican Chicken Tacos
description: A sweet and spicy Mexican dish featuring dark brown soft sugar, served in an earthenware bowl, this recipe is a low-calorie-friendly option for a flavorful meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the chicken, dark brown soft sugar, and taco seasoning until the chicken is well coated.
Knead the chicken mixture for 5 minutes until it is well combined.
Place the chicken mixture in an earthenware bowl and bake for 20 minutes.
While the chicken is baking, prepare the toppings by dicing the tomatoes and chopping the cilantro.
After the chicken has baked for 20 minutes, remove it from the oven and stir in the shredded cheese until it is melted and well combined.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the chicken mixture onto a tortilla and topping with diced tomatoes, chopped cilantro, sour cream, and a squeeze of lime juice.
Serve the tacos immediately and enjoy.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
